stepTitle: Identify the algebraic rule that is best illustrated by the visual model in the image.

figureAlts.figure1.gif: A diagram illustrating two equivalent arrangements of shapes. The shapes include two squares, three circles, and a lightning bolt. On the left side, the circles and lightning bolt are grouped together, separate from the squares. On the right side, the squares and circles are grouped together, separate from the lightning bolt. An equals sign connects the two sides.
